features.name: any_comment_list_and_colon
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain both a bulleted or numbered list and a colon?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads; malformed or missing -> null; empty list -> 0. For each comment string c: has_list = at least 2 lines matching regex (?m)^\s*(?:[-*•+]|\d+[.)])\s+\S ; has_colon = ':' in c. Value = 1 if any comment has has_list and has_colon in the same comment, else 0. Raw text matching; no semantic filtering.

h0: Discussions with and without a comment combining a list and a colon (any_comment_list_and_colon) have the same association with delta.
h1: Discussions with any_comment_list_and_colon=1 are more likely to have delta=1 than those with 0.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view); association only. Operational assumptions: "combine" means list and colon co-occur in the same comment (colon anywhere, not necessarily introducing the list); list = at least 2 line-start bullet or numbered items; markdown-stripped formatting may be lost. Comments are unordered and have no per-comment outcomes, so effect is at discussion level. Raw text may contain outcome announcements (not filtered).
